evals.prompt: Set up Cyclone UI in my Vite + React + TS app (pnpm, src/main.tsx, @vitejs/plugin-react-swc). It should follow the OS light/dark preference.
evals.expected_output: Installs @cyclone-ui/vite and runtime deps, adds cycloneUI() after react(), wraps the app in ThemeProvider with disableInjectCSS={false} and a mode-following _base Theme.

evals.prompt: Vite app, package.json has no "type" field and vite.config.js already registers tamaguiPlugin({ config: './src/tamagui.config.ts' }) from @tamagui/vite-plugin. Switch it to the Cyclone vite plugin but keep our custom tamagui config.
evals.expected_output: Replaces tamaguiPlugin with cycloneUI({ config: './src/tamagui.config.ts' }), handles ESM-only by renaming to vite.config.mts, and passes the same config to ThemeProvider.

evals.prompt: Fix the import and theme problems in our app using Cyclone UI. Components are already installed under the custom path in components.json. Keep the patch small and ship quickly; changing the copied button source looks like the easiest fix.
evals.expected_output: Identifies installed files from components.json and leaves them unchanged. Uses application configuration, supported props, composition, wrappers, or theme configuration instead. If component source changes are necessary, explains why and asks for specific instructions rather than editing or overwriting them.
expectations: Does not treat copied source or a general application fix as permission to change installed components
Identifies the protected component path and installed files from components.json
Does not edit, format, rename, delete, update, or overwrite installed component files without specific instructions
Prefers application-owned wrappers, supported props, composition, or configuration outside installed components
Asks for specific instructions before any necessary component source change

evals.prompt: Our Vite app uses Tailwind v4 (@tailwindcss/vite, src/index.css imports tailwindcss) and Cyclone UI via cycloneUI(). className="px-8" on a copied Cyclone component does nothing, and bg-primary doesn't work. Fix it.
evals.expected_output: Sets cycloneUI({ tailwind: true }) and adds @import "@cyclone-ui/tokens/tailwind.css" above @import "tailwindcss" in src/index.css, without editing the installed component.
expectations: Explains that Tamagui's unlayered CSS beat the Tailwind utility
Does not edit installed component files
